headline: Siddhartha Roy Burman files SEBI Takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Siddhartha Roy Burman submitted a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) to NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Khadim India Limited. The filing signifies a trigger event requiring mandatory public disclosure of shareholding changes.
detail: Siddhartha Roy Burman, identified in the disclosure, has filed the required Form under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), with the NSE. This regulation mandates disclosure within two trading days of crossing prescribed shareholding thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, etc.). The disclosure itself does not reveal the transaction size, price or date of acquisition; these details appear in the appended disclosure form. Khadim India Limited is a publicly listed footwear company traded on NSE and BSE.
